AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION MEETING
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  613 E. Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the City webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, Amazon Fire, iOS and
Android devices using a free app called Cablecast and choosing "Glendale TV" from the menu.
Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas.
Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. For public comments and questions during the
meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will be taken when that
agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for
assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. The City Clerk’ office should be notified 72 hours (three
business days) or as soon as practicable for requests regarding sign language translation and
Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that are
received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review
in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting or as soon as
practicable. Please specify the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City
provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak
in their native language.

  2.  CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the

  a. Minutes of the July 20, 2023 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting.

3.  INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Edith Aleksandryan, Student Ex-Officio Commissioner
  b. Jemma Pogosian, Student Ex-Officio Commissioner
  c. Celine Avedian, Public Arts Intern

4.  WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, September 21, 2023, at 10:00 a.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on September 21, 2023, at 10:04 a.m.
  •  Present: Commissioner Tufenkian, Yank, Zadorian, Chairperson Viar
  •  Absent: Commissioner Vidor
  •  The Agenda for the September 21, 2023, Regular Meeting was posted on September 18, 2023, on
  the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2. CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the Commission or the
  audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such request before motion is proposed.

  a. Minutes of the July 20, 2023 Regular Arts and Culture Commission Meeting

  Moved:  Commissioner Yank
  Seconded :  Commissioner Zadorian

  Ayes:  Commissioners Tufenkian, Yank, Zadorian Chairperson Viar
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Vidor
  Abstain:  None

3. INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  a. Edith Aleksandryan, Student Ex-Officio Commissioner
  • Ms. Aleksandryan introduced herself to the Commission and gave a brief introduction of her goals
  being part of the Commission.
  b. Jemma Pogosian, Student Ex-Officio Commissioner
  • Ms. Pogosian introduced herself to the Commission and gave a brief introduction of her goals being
  part of the Commission.
  c. Celine Avedian, Public Arts Intern
  • Ms. Avedian introduced herself to the Commission and gave a brief introduction of her goals being
  part of the Commission.
  • The Commission welcomed the student voices.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones welcomed the Student Commissioners and Public Arts Intern and thanked LA
  County Department of Arts & Culture for the grant received for Ms. Avedian’s position.
  d. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Loreto Lopez, Program
  Coordinator
  • Ms. Loreto Lopez gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts &
  Culture locations.

  1
 4. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS- NONE

5. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes. Members of
  the Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the Speaker, but there will be no Debate or
  Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  – No Speakers

6. DISCUSSION ITEM(s) / REPORT(s)
  a. 2022-2023 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Mural Ordinance – Update
  • Staff stated that the Mural Ordinance in addition to Policies and Procedures is in its final stages
  and being reviewed by City Attorney office. The draft final Mural Ordinance and Policies and
  Procedures will be scheduled for initial review by the Commission sometime in October for
  Commission feedback. Staff also stated they have been working with Beatify Earth and a meeting
  will hopefully be scheduled sometime in January.
  i. Creative Crosswalks – Request for Proposals
  • Staff stated that they are working with Public Works to release another Request for Proposals
  (RFP) which include opportunities for crosswalk and intersection designs for the San Fernando
  Road Beautification Project and Artsakh Ave. Re-Development Project.

  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i.  Beyond the Box – Update
  • Ms. Loreto gave a brief overview for this year’s Beyond the Box Utility Box Mural Program and
  state that this year’s theme is “Celebrating Inclusion”. On September 13, 2023, the Artist Review
  and Selection Committee met to review finalists for this year’s Beyond the Box Utility Box Mural
  Art Program. Staff received 120 applications for this year’s program, 12 finalists were shared
  during the September 21, 2023 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission.

  i.  PERFORMING ARTS – No Update
  ii.  ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update
  iii.  MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS – No Update

  b. Sponsorship Guidelines

  • Staff state that it has finalized the Arts and Culture Commission Guidelines and Requirements,
  Sponsorship Request Form, and Sponsorship webpage on the Arts and Culture Commission
  website and can be found at the following URL:
  www.glendaleartsandculture.org/commissionsponsorship.
  • Commission asked questions and gave their input.

  7. COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS
  •  Commissioner Tufenkian asked for clarification about the Sponsorship guidelines, and Staff
  provided feedback.
  •  Commissioner Zadorian suggested adding in a budget about or an amount not to exceed
  amount. Staff stated they can add the budget on the guidelines.
  •  Commissioner Yank asked about the Creative Crosswalk RFP and suggested more information
  on Specifications for artists and color specifications. Staff suggested it would reach out to Public
  Works for clearer dimensions and include the language to the RFP.
  •  Commissioner Tufenkian asked for clarification regarding budget and timeframe for the Creative
  Crosswalks program. Staff stated they will make sure the artists are aware of the timeline and
  budget.
  2
   •  The Commission welcomed and thanked the new intern and student commissioners to the Arts
  and Culture Commission; New student commissioners expressed their gratitude to the
  Commission and are excited to use their platform to bring awareness about the Arts to Glendale
  and congratulated Armenia for their Independence Day.
  •  Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that she wanted to thank David Ligtenberg, Assistant City Attorney
  for his work and congratulated and wished him luck on his next endeavor as a City Attorney in
  Oregon.
  •  Chairperson Viar welcomed the new intern and student voices and stated she’s excited for all
  the upcoming art installations and programs happening around Glendale. She also stated she
  would like to adjourn the meeting in memory of all of the Armenians who have given their lives
  over the years, the genocide and through all the struggles historically and cotemporary.

8. ADJOURNMENT - 10:30 am
The next Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is October 19, 2023, at 10:00 a.m., in City
Council Chambers (2nd Floor), 613 E. Broadway.
